title: TOPAS MC - Ion Karbon 330 MeV
description: Monte Carlo microdosimetry analysis of a mono-energetic 330 MeV/u carbon ion beam for predicting RBE of carbon ion therapy. Full paper ready.
long_description:
TOPAS MC — ION KARBON 330 MEV
• Monte Carlo simulation of a mono-energetic 330 MeV/u carbon ion beam in a water phantom
• Built with TOPAS v3.9 on the Geant4 toolkit

TECH APPROACH
• TOPAS microdosimetric extension + 3D SOI Bridge microdosimeter (59×72 silicon SVs, 30×30×10 µm³) for micron-scale energy deposition
• Mono-energetic beam (12C6+, 3960 MeV / 330 MeV/u, spread 0.1%) — no SOBP, isolates the microdosimetry-to-RBE link
• Physics lists: g4em-standard_opt4, QGSP_BIC_HP, binary cascade (validated for heavy-ion transport)
• Histories: 10⁵ plateau / 10⁶ Bragg / 10⁷ tail for statistical accuracy
• Scored frequency- & dose-mean lineal energy (yF̄, yD̄) from microdosimetric spectra

RBE MODEL
• Modified Microdosimetric Kinetic Model (mMKM) converts yD̄ → RBE10
• HSG cell params: α₀ = 0.13 Gy⁻¹, β = 0.05 Gy⁻², rd = 0.42 µm; reference 200 kVp X-rays (αX = 0.19, βX = 0.05)

RESULTS (RINGKAS)
• Bragg peak at 201.0 mm vs experiment 198.19 mm → ~2.8 mm range difference
• yD̄ rises toward Bragg peak, max ≈ 272 keV/µm at 202 mm
• RBE10: ≈ 1.17 at entrance → max 3.02 ± 0.38 at 201 mm → gradual decrease beyond
• Elevated RBE past peak driven by secondary nuclear fragments

title: TOPAS MC - RBE Ion Karbon 194 MeV/u
description: Analisis Relative Biological Effectiveness terapi ion karbon monoenergetik 194 MeV/u dengan simulasi Monte Carlo berbasis TOPAS dan mikrodosimeter SOI.
long_description:
TOPAS MC - RBE ION KARBON 194 MeV/u
Analisis nilai Relative Biological Effectiveness (RBE10) pada terapi ion karbon monoenergetik 194 MeV/u menggunakan simulasi Monte Carlo berbasis TOPAS.

TECH APPROACH
• Simulasi TOPAS 3.9 (Geant4) berkas 12C monoenergetic 194 MeV/u pada fantom PMMA
• Mikrodosimeter Silikon-on-Insulator (SOI) mencatat spektrum lineal energy skala mikrometer
• Pembanding: mikrodosimeter Tissue-Equivalent Proportional Counter (TEPC) dari studi sebelumnya
• Beam: distribusi posisi Gaussian (sigma = 11 mm) - pencil beam scanning
• SOI: step resolution 1 um, scoring via TsYScorer untuk yF, yD, dan estimasi RBE (MK Model)

RBE MODEL
• Modified Microdosimetric Kinetic Model (mMKM) mengonversi dose-mean lineal energy (yD) ke RBE10
• Referensi radiasi foton (LQ param) dihubungkan dengan spektra mikrodosimetri Monte Carlo

RESULTS (RINGKAS)
• RBE10 naik: 1,40 entrance -> maksimum 2,91 di puncak Bragg (70 mm) -> 1,15 distal tail
• yD memuncak 234,36 keV/um di 70 mm, turun 11,65 pada 153 mm
• Puncak Bragg simulasi 70 mm vs eksperimen 65 mm (pergeseran 5 mm, masih konsisten)
• SOI: resolusi spasial tinggi, estimasi RBE10 lebih stabil dibanding TEPC
